rv.q: Director Michael Donovan has brought to the stage a splashy, fizzy, joyful treat.

Last but not least, Catch Me If You Can serves up a surprisingly touching love story between Frank Jr. and nurse Brenda Strong (Gabbie Adner), a romance that allows us to discover in Frank the soul of a romantic to match the father-son relationship that develops unexpectedly between pursuer and pursued.
The musical lives in that uncomfortable gap between admiring his nerve and recognizing what his fantasy life can cost other people.

cn.t: This glossy, exuberant revival of the con-artist musical delivers crowd-pleasing entertainment with its 1960s style and morally complicated take on the American dream, earning strong marks from critics.
